chunks: He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji’abi reported to me from Abu al-Abbas, Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Saeed al-Hamadani, who reported from Abu Musa, Harun ibn Amru al-Majashi’i, who reported from Muhammad ibn Ja’far ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his forefathers, peace be upon them, from his grandfather, who said: The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and his progeny, said:

"A learned man among the ignorant is like a living person among the dead. And everything, including the fish of the sea, the creeping creatures of the earth, the wild beasts of the land, and its cattle, seek forgiveness for the seeker of knowledge. So seek knowledge, for it is the means between you and Allah, the Mighty and Majestic. And seeking knowledge is an obligation upon every Muslim."

key_terms.السبب: The means or connection; here referring to knowledge as the link between humanity and God
key_terms.العالم: The learned one; a person of knowledge
key_terms.فريضة: Obligation; religious duty incumbent upon every Muslim

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Muhammad say about the obligation of seeking knowledge?
ai.summary: This prophetic tradition, transmitted through the chain of Imams back to the Prophet Muhammad, establishes the supreme importance of seeking knowledge in Islam. The Prophet uses the vivid metaphor of a scholar among the ignorant being like a living person among the dead, and declares that all of creation -- from the fish of the sea to the beasts of the land -- pray for the seeker of knowledge. He concludes with the famous declaration that seeking knowledge is obligatory for every Muslim, making it one of the foundational hadiths on the obligation of learning.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 1. He said: Abu Bakr Muhammad ibn Umar al-Ji’abi reported to me from Abul Abbas, Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Saeed al-Hamadani, who reported from Abu Musa, Harun ibn Amru al-Majaashei, who reported from Muhammad ibn Ja’far ibn Muhammad, from his father, who reported from his grandfather that: The Prophet (peace be upon him and his progeny), said:

"A learned man among the ignorant people is like a living person among the dead. And everything, including the fish, the poisonous vermins, the wild beasts and the cattle pray for the forgiveness of the one who seeks knowledge. So, seek knowledge, for surely, it is a conducive mean between you and Allah, Most High. And surely, seeking of knowledge is obligatory upon every Muslim."
